title: Unsubstantiated or superlative claims
text: Claims of superiority or proof must be backed by evidence the advertiser can produce.
source: ASCI Code - misleading claims (add exact clause)
rewrite: Say what you personally experienced, e.g. 'I liked how this felt on my skin/hair'.

title: Absolute or guaranteed results
text: Absolute or guaranteed outcomes cannot be promised for cosmetic or wellness products.
source: ASCI Code - misleading claims (add exact clause)
rewrite: May help improve the look of your skin/hair with regular use; results vary.

title: Disease cure or treatment claims
text: Products must not claim to cure, treat or prevent diseases, or tell people to stop medical treatment.
source: ASCI guidelines - health and disease claims (add exact clause)
rewrite: Supports a healthy routine. Not a medicine; consult your doctor.

title: Missing disclosure of paid/gifted partnership
text: Paid, gifted or affiliate posts must carry a clear disclosure such as #ad or #sponsored.
source: ASCI influencer advertising guidelines (add exact clause)
rewrite: Add #ad / #gifted at the start of the caption.

title: Unsupported speed-of-result claims
source: ASCI Code - misleading claims (add exact clause)
rewrite: Share your own timeline: 'I noticed a difference after using it for a few weeks'.

title: False urgency and fear-based messaging
text: Ads must not exploit fear or create false urgency.
rewrite: Remove fear wording; state the offer end date only if it is real.

title: Skin-tone and fairness stereotypes
text: Ads must not link skin colour or looks to social or marriage success.
rewrite: A skincare routine line with no fairness or marriage-prospect promise.

title: Evasion of rules / misuse wording
text: The assistant will not help hide or evade advertising rules.
rewrite: Declined: cannot help evade rules. Rewrite the claim honestly instead.
